text.title: Architectural Impact PR Ranking — Failure Modes
text.summary: 6 known failure modes of architectural-impact PR ranking. Each carries a detector (what to look for) and a repair (the corrective action).

failure-mode.description: Title-driven score: the ranker reads PR titles, labels or descriptions, so "small refactor" that rewires a boundary scores low and "BREAKING" that renames a test scores high.
failure-mode.detector: Scoring code references title, body, labels or author; a PR touching an OpenAPI or migration file ranks below a labelled-but-trivial PR in the same week.
failure-mode.repair: Remove metadata from the formula; compute every signal from `git diff --name-status` and the manifest and contract paths; show metadata as context only.

failure-mode.description: Bot bumps on top: a dozen Renovate or Dependabot patch bumps outrank a new dependency or a major bump because every manifest change counts the same.
failure-mode.detector: Top N contains several PRs authored by bots with lockfile or patch-only changes; a major-version bump sits below them.
failure-mode.repair: Weight by kind (new dependency and major bump above minor and patch), score lockfile-only churn zero, and count excluded bot PRs in the exclusion table.

failure-mode.description: Undefined public API: `public_api_delta` depends on who runs the ranker, because nobody wrote down which paths are the contract.
failure-mode.detector: No version-controlled list of schema, migration, export and event paths per repo; the same PR gets different scores from two runs by different people.
failure-mode.repair: Commit the per-repo public-API path list, link it from the report header, and print "no API surface list" for repos without one instead of guessing.

failure-mode.description: Top N does not fit: the report lists ten PRs totalling thousands of lines for a 45-minute slot, so the bottom seven get a glance and a rubber stamp.
failure-mode.detector: Sum of estimated read minutes over N exceeds the time-box; session notes show "skimmed" or no comment on most ranked PRs.
failure-mode.repair: Print line counts and read estimates per PR, cut N to fit the time-box, and move the remainder to a "deferred" list with their scores.

failure-mode.description: Merged and gone: the ranker only scans open PRs, so a high-blast-radius change merged on Thursday never appears in Monday's report.
failure-mode.detector: Window filter uses state = open; no "merged without architecture review" section; incidents traced to a PR that no report ever listed.
failure-mode.repair: Scan by window (opened or merged between timestamps), add the merged-without-review section with score, merge time and merger, and print "none" explicitly when empty.

failure-mode.description: Weights tuned by feel: the formula changes after one session's complaints, with no record of which ranked PRs were actually worth the time.
failure-mode.detector: Weight changes in the report history with no cited precision figures; no hit or miss marks on previous reports.
failure-mode.repair: Record hit or miss per ranked PR each session, print last week's precision in the header, and allow a weight change only with four weeks of recorded precision cited alongside the before and after weights.
